acceptance.expected: A task routes to one authoritative workflow and the intended project skill; unrelated requests do not activate it.
Feature implementation depends on reviewed spec/test-plan contents; stale or unsupported approval cannot advance readiness.
Applicable existing authorization is reused; publication, remote management, merge, and deployment scopes remain explicit.
Substantial standard functionality receives a documented reuse/dependency decision; trivial tasks avoid compulsory external research.
Reuse candidates have a consumer, interface, provenance, and extraction cost; no candidate is an acceptable documented result.
One local command produces deterministic headless UI evidence from the real mock app without external services or browser-use tools.
Before/after screenshots and approved references match scenario/environment metadata and the exact source contents.
Independent QA reports reproducible findings and missing coverage without changing the acceptance contract.
Delivery validation rejects missing, failed, stale, or mismatched mandatory evidence and produces a readable English PR body.
CI publishes sanitized evidence securely and exposes a stable required check without blocking unrelated docs changes.
GitHub planning is idempotent; authorized mutations and administrative controls are applied and verified separately.
Fixed eval cases compare baseline/candidate outcomes; mandatory failures cannot be averaged away.
OKF finds all program pages and their relationships; new policy has one source of truth and repaired metadata validates.
Skills are portable, project installation preserves unrelated content, and normal development, E2E, and production behavior remain protected.
